column1: # [Stand-in] Hoenn geography that BC places don't share. The abandoned ship is the real S.S. BEAVER
# (Hudson's Bay Company steamer, wrecked at Prospect Point in 1888); DEEP COVE sits in a fjord, not a
# crater; WHISTLER is a mountain town up the SEA TO SKY, not an island. Owner to approve.
DEEP COVE sprang up as a town in the crater of a volcano.
column2: DEEP COVE sits deep inside INDIAN ARM, a fjord carved by glaciers.

column1: If you look up at the sky, the lip of the crater is also visible. So, all you see is the sky in a circle.
column2: Cliffs rise on every side of the cove, so all you see is a ring of sky.

column1: A circle of a night sky framed by the crater of a volcano…
column2: A circle of night sky framed by the cliffs of the cove…

column1: An underwater volcano erupted and forced itself up from the depths.
column2: Long ago, glaciers carved this inlet deep into the mountains.

column1: Its crater emerged from the sea and became filled with rainwater.
column2: When the ice melted, the sea flowed in and filled the cove.

column1: Travel to the easternmost reaches of BC, to the island WHISTLER.
column2: Travel north up the SEA TO SKY, to the mountain town of WHISTLER.
